question: Where in India was the Indian music director and classical flautist Pandit Hariprasad Chaurasia born?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Prayagraj**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pandit Hariprasad Chaurasia** was born in **Prayagraj**, Uttar Pradesh, India.
 
• He is an internationally acclaimed **classical flautist** and has significantly contributed to Indian music.
 
• He has received numerous awards, including the **Padma Vibhushan**, India's second-highest civilian award.
 
• Chaurasia is known for his pioneering work in bringing the flute into the mainstream of Indian classical music.
 
• He has collaborated with various international artists and has also composed music for several Bollywood films.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Prayagraj**, formerly known as Allahabad, is a major city in the Indian state of Uttar Pradesh.
 
• It is known for its rich history and cultural heritage, and is a prominent center for education and administration.
 
• The city is famous for hosting the **Kumbh Mela**, one of the largest religious gatherings in the world.
 
• Prayagraj is also a significant location in Hindu mythology, being the site of the confluence of three rivers: the Ganges, the Yamuna, and the mythical Saraswati.
